Gambler's ruin with p=2/3 (up), q=1/3 (down). Ratio r = q/p = 1/2.

Probability of reaching N=6 starting from i=3:
P = (1 - r^i)/(1 - r^N) = (1 - (1/2)^3)/(1 - (1/2)^6)

Numerator: 1 - 1/8 = 7/8
Denominator: 1 - 1/64 = 63/64

P = (7/8)/(63/64) = (7/8)·(64/63) = (7·64)/(8·63) = 448/504 = 8/9

Final answer: 8/9
